newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-AVALANCHE SIGNS FORSBERG TO THREE-YEAR DEAL.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-AVALANCHE SIGNS FORSBERG TO THREE-YEAR DEAL.

text.p: The Colorado Avalanche rewarded star centre Peter Forsberg for leading them to the NHL's best record by signing him to a new three-year contract on Tuesday.

The 23-year-old Forsberg, in his third year with the club, is second on the team with 51 points this season despite missing 17 games due to injury. He has 12 goals and 39 assists with a plus-21 rating.

"Happiness and winning are a priority in my life and I know I will have that playing here in Colorado," said Forsberg. "These are the reasons why I have agreed to terms right now instead of electing free agency next July."

Forsberg was named the 1995 NHL Rookie of the Year after compiling 15 goals and 35 assists for the Quebec Nordiques. After the team became the Avalanche, he finished fifth in the league in points (116) and fourth in assists (86) as Colorado captured the Stanley Cup.
Forsberg was the last player still under a Canadian contract since the team moved from Quebec.
Colorado (35-14-8) currently has 78 points and leads the Pacific Division by 16 points over Edmonton.
